# Decision memo: Fund billing/support next quarter, led by BIL-PAYWALL, the top actionable issue and the area whose complaint share rose most steeply at the end of the window

*Recommended area: **billing/support** · Generated by `claude-sonnet-5-5` (effort high) from `evidence_pack.json` · Checker: **passed** · Input `spotify_reviews_18months.csv` · 660609 classified reviews, 0 unclassified.*

## Recommendation
Fund **billing/support** next quarter, starting with **BIL-PAYWALL** (features such as song choice and skips locked behind Premium, including paying users who still find features not working). It is the top actionable issue by priority score [C3]. It is also where the end-of-window movement is clearest. Playback and usability remain close alternatives, discussed below.

## Ranking basis
The required baseline ranking has OTH-GENERAL (general dissatisfaction, no specific defect) at baseline rank 1, with complaint_count 85894 [C1] and priority_score 180521 [C2]. BIL-PAYWALL is at baseline rank 2, with priority_score 118521 [C3]. `ranking_actionable_top10` is an additional view that drops only OTH-GENERAL, because no team can fix a complaint that names no specific defect. It does not change any other issue's numbers. In that actionable view BIL-PAYWALL is at rank 1. In the without_needs_review sensitivity ranking it is at rank 3, behind OTH-GENERAL and USA-ADS.

## Evidence
- BIL-PAYWALL has complaint_count 38784 [C4] and mean_severity 3.055925 [C5]. That is 13.3 percent of baseline complaint records, and 6494 of its records carry cancellation language (expressed intent, not observed churn).
- At area level, billing/support has 51040 complaint records, severity_sum 154065, and 8263 cancellation records. 8263 is larger than the cancellation count of every other area in area_rollup.
- Timing strongly favors this area. Billing/support's monthly complaint share was 13.5 percent (5601 records) in 2023-09 and 26.3 percent (23442 records) in 2023-10, the last full month. In the partial final month, 2023-11, it was 19.7 percent (6805 records). In 2023-10, usability was 13.0 percent, playback 7.8 percent and access 1.4 percent. So recent movement sharpens the full-period picture, in which billing/support is not the largest area.
- Representative reviews: 1be24878-5115-490a-bb7f-dad95d0630ab (cancelled Premium over the lock-in), b5543c5b-e63b-4e70-a915-de5d3a01f9d3 (payment changes plus intrusive ads even with Premium), and cff065a1-e826-4ea2-af1d-dd43f7ebcf4f (rejoining Premium).

## Alternatives considered
- **Playback (incl. downloads):** over the full period it is larger on severity_sum (193130) and complaint count (57248) than billing/support. PLY-WONTPLAY has priority_score 58604 [C6]. Label reliability is weaker, though. The verifier agreed on area for 34 of 53 sampled playback complaints. It agreed on topic for only 2 of 12 sampled PLY-GENERAL records and 11 of 20 PLY-WONTPLAY records, so playback labels are less certain. Its share was also flat in the last full month (7.8 percent).
- **Usability:** 66495 complaint records and severity_sum 174227. USA-ADS has priority_score 87029 [C7], and its labels held up well (35 of 37 topic agreement). It is a strong runner-up. Of 44 sampled BIL-PAYWALL records, the verifier placed 9 in usability, so the billing/usability boundary overlaps (skips, ads in Premium). Coordinate the two teams.
- **Access:** small by volume (11644 complaint records, severity_sum 45817), but ACC-LOGIN has mean_severity 3.972966 [C8] and 12 of 13 sampled topic agreement. It is a targeted fix, not the quarter's main bet.

## Risks and limitations
- Reviews are self-selected and historical. There is no revenue, plan tier or confirmed churn data, so nothing here estimates revenue, churn or users affected.
- Labels come from a classifier. The needs_review share is 31.9 percent of all classified reviews (210531 records). Non-English reviews are flagged needs_review. 13 records were quarantined out of 660609 completed classifications.
- Label agreement for BIL-PAYWALL was 35 of 44 sampled records, and billing/support area agreement was 45 of 57. Samples are small, so these are indicative only.
- The spike in 2023-10 coincides with a large review volume (89102 classified reviews). It may reflect a specific event, and the data cannot show cause.

## Next steps
1. Audit a fresh sample of BIL-PAYWALL reviews with humans, splitting true paywall complaints from ads and usability complaints.
2. Map which gated features (skips, song choice, playlist use) drive the most severe complaints, and scope messaging or entitlement fixes.
3. Check whether paying users report features not working, and open a support-side fix for entitlement errors.
4. Run a joint billing and usability review of Premium ad exposure (USA-ADS overlap).
5. Track monthly billing/support share after the final partial month and re-rank when more data arrives.
